title: Student OS
description: Students: classes, tasks, notes and study time in one dashboard for the term.

spec.useCase: Maya Okonkwo is a sophomore juggling five classes and uses this to see what is due, how each class is going and where her study time goes.

How to read this page
Not done lists everything still open, soonest first.
Minutes by class shows whether study time matches the credits.
A short routine that keeps the whole term in one place.
On the first day of class, add the class and read the syllabus for every due date and its weight.
Add each assignment, quiz and exam as a task with its weight. Set the score once it is returned.
Each morning open Due soon and pick the three tasks that matter most today.
After every lecture, add a note and tick Reviewed once you have gone over it.
Log a study session when you finish one so the dashboard shows where the time went.
Weight is the share of the final grade. Weighted earned is score times weight, so you can add it up per class.

Every lecture note opens with a layout: topic, key ideas, questions and a summary written from memory. Unreviewed notes show in the To review list.
Lecture, reading and lab notes in one place. Group by class to revise before an exam.
Review rhythm
Same day: tidy the note and write the summary.
Two days later: test yourself from the questions.
Before the exam: reread only the questions you missed.
